system.description: If you draw a concealed weapon and, before the end of the same round, make an attack against a target that failed to notice the item, the target is considered Flat-Footed against you. You can draw a concealed item or a stowed item as a Move Action. Additionally, if you have the Quick Draw feat, you can reduce this to a Swift Action.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Force Unleashed Campaign Guide
